text:
Noah: FYI - brought up q4b-lite on the staging bucket. Quick baseline vs prod shows a consistent drop in multi-step instruction recall (2.8-4.2%). Small but reproducible.
Sofie: Oof. Which slice? small_instruct or troubleshooting?
Noah: mostly troubleshooting prompts that require explicit steps. Ran local eval: `./eval_harness --model q4b-lite --prompts promptsets/troubleshoot_short_2026.json --metrics recall@1,rerank --out tmp/q4blite.json`
Amir: before we spam humans, run a near-duplicate scan. Last month we had paraphrase collapse causing false positives.
Noah: running `python tools/near_dupe.py --input tmp/q4blite.json --sim_thresh 0.88` now.
(10m)
Noah: dup report: 7 exact dup, 11 near-dupe (0.86-0.93). About 0.7% exact. Not enough to explain the behavior.
Sofie: OK create a micro-golden for the worst 80 diffs. Use blind pair relabel by seniors, plus adversarial paraphrase step.
Sofie: @label-bot create --batch "q4b-lite-rerank-80" --size 80 --golden true --owners Sofie,Amir --priority high
label-bot: batch q4b-lite-rerank-80 queued. ETA 8-12h. React with :eyes: to allow auto-accept by senior reviewers.
Amir: add a quant-sensitivity sweep toggling kv_cache and prefill_len; also run a kernel-precision comparison (fast vs stable). Command: `./quant_sweep --model q4b-lite --flags kv_cache:{on,off},prefill:{0,16},kernel:{fast,stable}`
Noah: spun up canary route pinned to q4b-lite for 1% on the troubleshooting route. Deploy id 81234. ops-bot, set retention 72h and add top-k rerank and user-helpful events to the dashboard.
ops-bot: Canary created canary/q4b-lite-1pct (deploy 81234). Retention set 72h. Alerts to #eng-ml on quality threshold breach.
Sofie: labeling criteria: pass if gold-precision >= 0.93 and senior agreement >= 0.9. If pass-rate < 0.97 or entailment delta > 0.025 we hold rollout. Decision owners: Sofie + Noah.
Noah: I'll snapshot promptset and tag examples with metadata: ["q4b-investigate","troubleshoot_2026"], snapshot id snap-1772104321. Also adding provenance: eval_run:1772104321.
Amir: I'll run pairwise semantic similarity (BERTScore) on top-5 answers to detect semantic drift beyond exact-match.
Sofie: good. If humans find systematic omission of steps, we may need a targeted golden expansion and a small prompt engineering rollback test.
label-bot: human batch assigned to Sofie, Amir. Expected results by 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC.
Noah: monitoring quant sweep + golden results. Will post summary and recommended action (promote/rollback/patch) once we have gold. :eyes: 
Amir: ping me on call if pass-rate drops below thresholds or if canary latency spikes.
Sofie: thanks all, keep notes minimal in thread and attach full eval artifacts to the snapshot.
